description: Cinematic sci-fi survival showcase quest. Wake aboard a derelict mining station around a dying asteroid. Five vital systems are failing, an unknown signal pulses through the hull, and someone left a message just for you.
author: Showcase Studio

parameters.criticText: <fx pulse FF2020A0 1.4 3 fx><so alarm so>Your suit reads zero. The station fades. So does the rest.
<fx glitch 1.2 16 fx><fx tint AA20FFAA 0.6 fx>The voices win. You stop being you.
<fx flash A0FFFF 0.7 0.6 fx><fx fade out 0.6 fx>The signal locks. A distant rescue beacon answers. You did it.

descriptions:
<im cryo_pod im><mu ambient_dread mu><fx fade in 1.2 fx><fx overlay fog on fx>You wake. Frost on the inside of a cryopod. The glass is fogged. Red emergency light pulses in the corridor beyond.

A voice — flat, mechanical — speaks from a panel:
«Cryo-cycle interrupted. Oxygen reserves at 70 percent. Station integrity: critical. Welcome back, Specialist.»

Your suit boots. Your hands are cold. Five systems blink at you, demanding attention.

<im corridor im><so door_hiss so><fx vignette 000000A0 0.5 fx>The corridor stretches in both directions, lit only by the red pulse. Conduits hang from the ceiling. Vapour leaks from a torn seal.

A panel ahead says HUB. Behind you, AIRLOCK. To your left, a dark side passage with a single word stenciled on it: QUARTERS.

<im main_hub im><mu ambient_pulse mu><fx overlay scanlines on fx>You step into the Main Hub. A holographic map of the station rotates, half its sections rendered in red. Four working corridors branch out.

A console blinks: «Pick a system. Stabilize it. Then we talk.»

The voice does not sound like the one in your pod.

<im bridge im><so console_hum so>The bridge: shattered viewports, asteroid rock visible past the cracked glass. Stars drift in slow rotation. A captain's chair, empty, has a folded handwritten note on it.

The note reads: «If you read this, you are not alone aboard. Do not trust the system voice. — V.»

<fx shake 0.4 8 fx>Something thuds against the hull. Twice. Then silence.

<im medbay im><so heart_monitor so>The MedBay is silent. Six gurneys, six empty. A monitor flatlines at the far end without anyone attached to it.

A medical drone hovers, scanning you. It chirps. A green light turns on. A vial of clear liquid is dispensed into your hand: «Adrenaline. Use with caution.»

<im reactor im><mu reactor_hum mu><fx overlay sparks on fx><fx pulse FF4040AA 1.2 2 fx>The reactor core whines like a wounded animal. Coolant lines have ruptured. Heat shimmers off the housing.

A control panel shows three options: vent coolant, force a controlled restart, or seal the room and walk away. None of them look safe.

<im comms im><so radio_static so><fx overlay stars on fx>The Comms Array. A wall of receivers, each tuned to white noise.

A single transmitter waits, its boost amplifier capped at three settings. Each step up costs power, but pushes your distress call further.

The terminal asks: «How loud do you want to scream?»

<im storage im>Storage hold. Crates labelled in a dozen languages. The air here is cleaner, recycled through a stand-alone scrubber.

You could rest. Repair. Replenish your oxygen. Or pry open a crate marked CLASSIFIED — RIBBON CLEARANCE ONLY.

<im hidden_lab im><fx overlay shimmer on fx><fx tint 4080FF22 0.5 fx>A hidden lab behind the storage crate. Workbenches. Notebooks. Photographs of a woman with the same surname stencilled on the captain's note: V. Lindgren.

A single working terminal blinks: «Operator V. Lindgren — last login eleven days ago. Welcome back, V.»

You are not V. But the terminal thinks you are.

<im server_room im><mu ambient_low mu><fx overlay dust on fx>The server room: rack after rack of stripped-out drives. Whatever ran here has been gutted. Cables hang loose like cut nerves.

One drive remains, plugged into a maintenance terminal. The screen reads: «Decrypt log V-7?»

It will take power. It might cost sanity. It might give you the truth.

<im cargo im>Cargo hold. Heavy mining rigs strapped to the floor, asteroid samples sealed in cases.

One case is open. The sample inside is gone. The seal looks like it was opened from the inside.

<im observation im><mu ambient_deep mu><fx overlay stars on fx><fx vignette 000020A0 0.7 fx>The observation deck. Open vacuum behind reinforced glass, the asteroid filling half the view. Its surface pulses in slow magenta.

It should not pulse. Asteroids do not pulse. You watch anyway. The colour matches the rhythm of your own heart, when you check.

Something down there is listening.

<im quarters im><so paper_rustle so>Crew quarters. Six bunks, six locker tags. Five have personal things — photographs, a book, a child's drawing. The sixth, marked V. LINDGREN, is empty except for a single recorder.

The recorder is paused mid-message. You could press play. You might learn what happened.

<im engine_bay im><fx overlay sparks on fx>The engine bay. The drive is offline but warm. Someone — recently — diverted power away from life support and into something else. The trail leads to a sealed conduit headed deeper into the station.

You could reroute the power. You could leave it. You could follow the trail.

<im airlock im><so warning_klaxon so><fx overlay danger on fx><fx pulse FF1010CC 1.6 4 fx>The outer airlock. Pressure-wash burns on the deck. The inner door is intact, but the outer one is sealed with a manual override from the inside.

The console shows two ghost EVA suits unaccounted for. Whoever closed this door did it knowing they could not come back through.

<im signal_sent im><mu hopeful_outro mu><fx fade in 1.5 fx><fx overlay stars on fx>Your signal locks. A faint, calm voice answers from the dark:

«Station three-seven-nine, this is Anvil Relay. We have your coordinates. Tether on the way. Hold steady.»

You sink into the captain's chair. The pulse from the asteroid does not stop, but you do not have to listen to it any more.

<fx flash AAFFFF 0.8 0.5 fx>You survived. You were heard.

<im suffocation im><mu sad_outro mu><fx fade in 1.5 fx><fx tint 200000AA 0.8 fx>Your suit's HUD whites out. The corridors go dark and the dark goes quiet. Your last thought is a regret you cannot name.

<im truth im><mu hopeful_outro mu><fx overlay shimmer on fx><fx fade in 1.4 fx><fx flash A080FF 0.9 0.6 fx>You crack the encrypted log. You read V. Lindgren's last entry: she stayed behind so the asteroid could not follow her crew home.

You broadcast on her wavelength, with her name attached. The signal locks. Anvil Relay answers. And, far below, the asteroid stops pulsing.

You survived. You finished what she started. You did not just escape — you understood.

passages.question: Step into the corridor.
Walk to the Main Hub.
[story] Slip into the dark side passage to Quarters.
[story] Head for the Bridge.
[reward] Drop into MedBay for supplies.
[danger] Push to the Reactor Room.
Head straight for the Comms Array.
Search Storage for resources.
Return to the Main Hub.
[story] Follow the corridor to the Observation Deck.
[reward] Take the adrenaline shot. Steady your nerves.
passages.description: <fx flash A8FFA8 0.3 0.4 fx><so med_inject so>You inject. The room snaps into focus. Your hands stop shaking.

passages.question: Leave the vial. You don't trust mystery chemicals.
[danger] Vent coolant. Risky — but quick.
passages.description: <fx shake 0.55 22 fx><fx flash FF6020 0.4 0.6 fx><so explosion_small so>You vent. Steam screams through the bay. The reactor cools.

passages.question: Force a controlled restart.
Seal the reactor. Walk away.
[reward] Max amplifier. Send everything you have.
Medium boost. Conserve power.
Low boost. Hope someone is close.
[reward] Rest by the scrubber. Recover oxygen.
passages.description: <fx fade in 0.4 fx>You breathe slow, deep. Your suit refills.

passages.question: [story] Pry open the classified crate.
Continue to the Cargo Hold.
[story] Move into the Server Room.
Close it. Some doors should stay shut.
[reward] Decrypt log V-7. Spend the power. Learn the truth.
Leave the encrypted log. Not worth the cost.
[danger] Push to the Engine Bay.
Back away from the open case.
[danger] Stare back. Match the rhythm.
passages.description: <fx glitch 0.6 14 fx><fx tint A040FFAA 0.5 fx>You hold the rhythm in your chest. Something out there nods.

passages.question: Look away. Whatever it is, you owe it nothing.
[story] Play V. Lindgren's recorder.
passages.description: <so soft_static so><fx vignette 000020A0 0.6 fx>«If anyone wakes from cryo before relay confirms, do not — repeat, do not — open the asteroid sample. I am sealing the bay. I am sorry.»

passages.question: Leave the recorder. Stay focused on the present.
[danger] Follow the diverted power trail to the Airlock.
[reward] Reroute the power back to life support.
[reward] Use V. Lindgren's emergency frequency from the airlock.
[danger] Open the outer door. Walk out.
Step back. Return to the Hub.
